strategy.offer: Industrial coding and marking systems, plus service, training, accessories and consumables for direct identification of products, components and packaging.
strategy.customers: Industrial and retail operations across sectors such as food, pharmaceuticals, packaging and materials processing needing reliable coding on varied products and surfaces.
strategy.why_we_win: It expects to win by matching technologies to each surface and application, integrating easily into production lines, and delivering customized single-source solutions.
strategy.resources: It cites long experience, a unified operating concept, in-house development, production and service, certified quality processes, and an international sales and support network.
strategy.direction: It is heading toward more digitalized, production-wide identification and traceability for Industry 4.0 while further expanding global service and distribution coverage.
